name: project-cognition
description: Persistent incremental project indexing and compact task-context retrieval for ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription: Build and reuse a persistent structural index of project files, refresh only changed content, and generate compact task-specific context packs linked to original source files.
capabilities: Preserve local project knowledge across sessions
interface.defaultPrompt: Build or refresh project cognition for the current task, then verify important conclusions against source files.
